summary: SCS..UU linear bearing housing with its LM..UU bearing, shaft axis on z through the origin, base down along -y. Note: the library draws SCS8UU 36.2 wide while the vendor width is 34.

checks.source: SCS8UU vendor drawing (Misumi-type SCS housing): W 34, F 22, L 30, h 11 (B/2 + K = 17 is the nominal side edge, B/2 = W/2). The library's side width overshoots W/2 by 1.1 per side: sideX = 2 * (K - r - trapezoidX) in scs_bearing_block puts the actual edge at B/2 + 2K - r - trapezoidX = 18.1 (r = boltHoleRadius, the M4 clearance radius 2.2; trapezoidX = r - 0.5 is an estimate the drawings do not give), so the library draws x 36.2; OpenSCAD measures the same
